name: When The River Calls Your Name
source:
You are one of three scientists on a research trip to the Amazon River! Alongside your trusty guide you will be tasked with collecting samples, organizing research, and of course catching your own dinner! 

You're excited to be on this once in a lifetime trip for many reasons, but you can't deny the appeal of spending so much time with your very attractive companions!

Or, I suppose you could spend time with that strange creature in your dreams. It is just a dream after all, right? 

[From [url=https://corvidscauldron.itch.io/when-the-river-calls-your-name]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是前往亚马逊河进行研究之旅的三名科学家之一！除了值得信赖的导游之外，你还将负责收集样本、组织研究，当然还有自己的晚餐！

出于多种原因，你很高兴能够参加这次一生一次的旅行，但你不能否认与非常有吸引力的同伴一起度过这么多时间的吸引力！

或者，我想你可以和梦中那个奇怪的生物共度时光。这终究只是一个梦，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://corvidscauldron.itch.io/when-the-river-calls-your-name]itch.io[/url]]
